label: experimental, supplementary: CountQA-derived subset (439 questions), exemplar-free frozen FSC-147 heads; not official CountQA scores

protocol.unit: test image; seeds are never extra images
protocol.pairing: identical image IDs (sorted) and identical seeds; seed k of one cell with seed k of the other
protocol.mae: per-image absolute error averaged over seeds, then the paired difference of those means is resampled (vtb.geometry_bootstrap.paired_metric_bootstrap, higher_is_better=False)
protocol.rmse: per resample, each seed's RMSE on the drawn images, averaged over seeds, then differenced; 'pooled' gives sqrt(mean sq_error over all seed x image rows) from the same draws
protocol.draws: one image draw sequence (torch.Generator seed, batches of 256) shared by MAE and RMSE
protocol.point_estimate: the same statistic on the full paired sample
protocol.difference: second minus first; positive means the second cell has the larger error (first is better)
protocol.by_bin: resampled within the bin (counting.count_bin of the true count); small_sample when fewer than 30 images
protocol.stage_pairs: final Tower vs merged, merged vs projected, final Tower vs projected, one arm and capacity
protocol.arm: free vs exemplar at the final Tower on the exemplar arm's test IDs, same capacity
protocol.capacity: raw vs matched at the same Stage and arm
protocol.inputs: contract prediction TSVs (abs_error, sq_error columns); complete payloads only, or finished per-cell JSON + TSV pairs (marked partial)
